international.title: Australian politics live: Penny Wong to defend US alliance; Coalition condemns Vanuatu deal
international.summary: Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast ‘We all wish a consensus statement had been reached’: Wong Penny Wong knows a thing or two about not landing a deal at COP. Well, we all wish that a consensus statement had been reached. But I’ve been a climate minister and I’ve been at conferences before where we have not managed to reach an outcome. I was famously at Copenhagen, where we had world leaders there and we still were not able to land an agreement. I know what Chris Bowen has done has been to work extremely closely with the Pacific all the way through this process. And to keep faith with them. He sought to do that the whole way through, and I’m sure did so in Turkiye as well. And the reason we sought to participate here was because we wanted to keep faith with the Pacific on climate. The work that we are doing with other countries to secure our position, and how important that is – whether it’s the UK, Canada, the European Union. Or, also, our work in the region – our work with Japan. These are important elements about how you assure Australian security and make sure that we have different options, different pathways, to pursue our interests. Continue reading...
